description: Traces a normalized direction from a world location to find the first block hit, up to 1024 blocks away. A miss returns no block or location and Distance -1.

inputs.description: Starts this operation when the execution route is reached.

inputs.name: start_location
inputs.description: World location from which the block ray begins.

inputs.name: direction_vector
inputs.description: Finite, non-zero ray direction. Its length is normalized before tracing.

inputs.name: max_distance
inputs.description: Ray length from 0 through 1024 blocks. Defaults to 50.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues execution after this operation completes.

outputs.name: hit_block
outputs.description: First block hit by the ray, or no value when the ray misses.

outputs.name: hit_location
outputs.description: Exact world position of the ray hit, or no value when the ray misses.

outputs.name: distance
outputs.description: Distance from the ray start to the hit in blocks. Returns -1 on a miss.
